title: Power board: -20 V inverter
comments: TPS54560 as inverting buck-boost (TI SLVA317B): IC ground = -20V_CONV, 22 uH from SW to PGND
IC sees VIN + 20 V (44.7 V max, 58.9 V at the TVS clamp); C301/C302/C304 and the sync cap rated 100 V
Synced to CLK_B (opposite phase to the buck); UVLO start 21.1 V, stop moot once running (SLVA317)
Compensation for the right-half-plane zero (about 43 kHz): crossover about 1.7 kHz (design.py)
